hooks.command: repo_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && bundle="$repo_root/tools/truth-guard/bundles/f5a1423e5d2ec2a3688bedd12cf275de9999d5ce6565c887ecacb1f4c21823a6/truth-guard.pyz" && python3 -B -I -S -c 'import collections,hashlib,sys; h=hashlib.sha256(); stream=open(sys.argv[1],"rb"); collections.deque(map(h.update,iter(lambda:stream.read(1048576),b"")),maxlen=0); stream.close(); raise SystemExit(0 if h.hexdigest() == sys.argv[2] else 86)' "$bundle" f5a1423e5d2ec2a3688bedd12cf275de9999d5ce6565c887ecacb1f4c21823a6 && PYTHONUTF8=1 PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 python3 -B -I -S "$bundle" hook stop --repo-root "$repo_root"
hooks.commandWindows: $env:PYTHONUTF8='1'; $env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8'; $root = (& git rev-parse --show-toplevel); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $bundle = Join-Path $root 'tools\truth-guard\bundles\f5a1423e5d2ec2a3688bedd12cf275de9999d5ce6565c887ecacb1f4c21823a6\truth-guard.pyz'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $bundle -PathType Leaf)) { Write-Error 'Truth Guard bundle is missing.'; exit 86 }; $actual = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $bundle -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(); if ($actual -ne 'f5a1423e5d2ec2a3688bedd12cf275de9999d5ce6565c887ecacb1f4c21823a6') { Write-Error 'Truth Guard bundle SHA-256 mismatch before execution.'; exit 86 }; & python -B -I -S $bundle hook stop --repo-root $root; exit $LASTEXITCODE
